<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Hiring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/hiring">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJob" name="Post job on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidates" name="Select candidates for interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewPreference" name="Candidate interview preference"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose candidate"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationNeeded" name="Salary negotiation needed?">
      <bpmn:default>Flow_SkipNegotiation</bpmn:default>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferAccepted" name="Offer accepted?">
      <bpmn:default>Flow_OfferNotAccepted</bpmn:default>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OfferNotAccepted" name="Offer not accepted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IntegrateNewHire" name="Integrate new hire into the team"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FullyIntegrated" name="New hire fully integrated"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJob"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJob" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InPerson" name="In-person preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidatePreference = 'in-person'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Virtual" name="Virtual preferred" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewPreference" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">candidatePreference = 'virtual'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Negotiate" name="Negotiation needed" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationNeeded" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">salaryNegotiationNeeded = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipNegotiation" name="No negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OfferAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferAccepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferAccepted" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">offerAccepted = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferNotAccepted" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferAccepted" targetRef="EndEvent_OfferNotAccepted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Task_IntegrateNewHire"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_IntegrateNewHire" targetRef="EndEvent_FullyIntegrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
